manifest.description: Rewrite readers of a public-static-final holder field to use an injected DI provider expression. Ships the call-site rewrite half of note-7c819189 with auto-injection of the @Inject Provider field via the shared di_plumbing helper (delegate_type mode); manual pre-staged-field mode remains as an operator override. Holder-class conversion to @Singleton is still operator-driven.
when_to_use: remove `<HolderClass>.<STATIC_FIELD>` escape hatches around the DI graph by routing readers through an injected provider
anti_patterns: do not use to delete the holder class itself — this atom only rewrites readers; production-side holder conversion is a separate workflow

delegate_type.description: Type to auto-inject as the new receiver (e.g. `SiteAdmin`). When set, the planner synthesizes or reuses an `@Inject Provider<DelegateType>` field on the reader's enclosing class via the shared di_plumbing helper. Mutually exclusive with `new_text` (provide one).

new_text.description: Manual override: replacement receiver expression (e.g. `siteAdminProvider.get()`). Use when the provider field is already staged on the enclosing class and auto-injection should be skipped.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-migrate-static-holder. Charter: Rewrite `<HolderClass>.<STATIC_FIELD>` readers to an injected provider expression.

Protocol:

1. Ground:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")

2. Choose mode:
   - Auto-injection (default): pass `delegate_type=<HolderType>` and omit `new_text`. The planner synthesizes or reuses an `@Inject Provider<HolderType>` field on the reader's enclosing class via the shared di_plumbing helper.
   - Manual override: the operator has already staged the provider field; pass `new_text="<provider>.get()"` and omit `delegate_type`.

3. Plan with item_kinds=["field"]:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="replace_java_static_reference",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}",
                      delegate_type="{{delegate_type}}",   # auto-inject mode; OR
                      new_text="{{new_text}}",             # manual override
                      item_names={{item_names}},
                      item_kinds=["field"])

4. Apply and compile-verify.

5. Emit done note.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{impl_name}} {{delegate_type}} {{new_text}} {{item_names}}
